name: cx-rules-only~p3
task: Do not take the box from the other room. At any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Absence(target_picked_up) is hard, matching the hard ban on taking the box. Response(has_door_key, door_open) is soft, matching the preference that the door be open whenever the key is held, at that moment or afterwards. Absence(key_lost) is soft, matching the preference not to drop the key while the door is closed. No clause adds an unstated requirement, and the rule-only warning is valid because the task commands no goal.
